about: Golden query set. Each query names the clip it is answered in and an ANCHOR: a phrase copied verbatim from that clip's transcript inside the answering passage. eval/build_golden.py locates the anchor's words and turns their timestamps into the labeled span (episode time) plus the speaker who said it, writing data/queries.json. Negative queries have no anchor: nothing in the collection answers them. Types: keyword (exact words), phrase (quoted), entity (names/organisations), semantic (paraphrase with little word overlap), speaker (speaker named in the query), role (host/guest in the query), typo (misspelled), negative.
